Description: 'Three-tier VPC with public, application, and database subnets across three availability zones'

    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  PublicSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.1.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for public subnet in AZ1'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  PublicSubnet2CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.2.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for public subnet in AZ2'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  PublicSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.3.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for public subnet in AZ3'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  AppSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.11.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for application subnet in AZ1'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  AppSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.13.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for application subnet in AZ3'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  DbSubnet1CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.21.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for database subnet in AZ1'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  DbSubnet2CIDR:

    Default: '10.0.22.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for database subnet in AZ2'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

  DbSubnet3CIDR:
    Type: String
    Default: '10.0.23.0/24'
    Description: 'CIDR block for database subnet in AZ3'
    AllowedPattern: '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/[0-9]{1,2}$'

    Default: 'production'
    Description: 'Environment name for tagging'

      - staging
      - development

          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

      VpcId: !Ref VPC

        - Key: Name

        - Key: Environment

        - Key: Tier

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet3CIDR

      Tags:
